name: Riverside Market
description: A bustling trade hub where the river meets the road.
rumors: The river's been running low this season. Bad omen, the fishermen say.
Borderkeep Castle has doubled its garrison. Something's got the lord spooked.
I heard there's good coin to be made clearing the roads of brigands.
A traveling healer passed through last week. Sold potions at a fair price.
